title: Green's Theorem for Rectangles via Interval Integrals

problemStatement.formal: For a rectangle [a,b] x [c,d], formalize Green's theorem in interval-integral form: the boundary integral of P dx + Q dy is equal to the double integral of partial_x Q - partial_y P, using the fundamental theorem of calculus, a Fubini hypothesis, linearity of integration, and ring arithmetic.
problemStatement.plain: Green's theorem for rectangles formalized using Mathlib's intervalIntegral machinery, replacing the abstract stub definitions with genuine FTC-based computations. The proof uses only FTC, Fubini (as hypothesis), linearity of integration, and ring arithmetic, demonstrating that Mathlib's analysis library is powerful enough for multivariable calculus.
